text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
――Ah, you're violating the Anti-Shade Monopoly Act~
I'm gonna tell te~ache~r☆

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
! Sky-san...
...What did you come here for?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
"What do you mean...? I was just looking for
the best spot to eat some ice cream."

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
...Didn't you say it tastes best
when eaten in an ice-cold,
air-conditioned room?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: "Sometimes in this sweltering heat, you just want to get a little chill... You know?"

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
...That's a lie. You just came to meddle.
Because of my bad test scores.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: "She was only five points lower than usual, right? I'm not going to worry about someone who's up that high."

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: A five-point gap is huge! Giving up points on such elementary mistakes... is hardly first-class.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Yet I'm not feeling down at all.
I was already thinking about what to do next.
So—

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
The bag feels all sloshy inside... Did the ice cream melt?
It's all King's fault for starting to monologue~.
Yep, that means you're treating us~ Off to the convenience store we go! ☆

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Wait...! Why is it my fault?!
I am definitely not treating you! ...Sky-san?!
